genre_map.title: POWER4 system microarchitecture
genre_map.authors_if_known: J. M. Tendler, J. S. Dodson, J. S. Fields Jr., H. Le, B. Sinharoy
genre_map.venue: IBM Journal of Research and Development
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: Microarchitectural implementation of the dual-core POWER4 processor, multi-core chip interconnect fabric, L2/L3 cache directory architecture, and SMP scalability decisions.

genre_map.title: Design and implementation of the POWER5 microprocessor
genre_map.authors_if_known: J. Clabes, J. Friedrich, M. Sweet, J. DiLullo, S. Chu, D. Plass, J. Dawson, P. Muench, L. Powell, M. Floyd, B. Sinharoy, M. Lee, M. Goulet, J. Wagoner, N. Schwartz, S. Runyon, G. Gorman, P. Restle, R. Kalla, J. McGill, S. Dodson
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: Physical implementation and circuit tuning of POWER5 in 130nm SOI CMOS, multi-threshold voltage (multi-Vt) transistor assignment, dynamic clock gating, and area vs. performance trade-offs for simultaneous multithreading (SMT).

genre_map.title: A 600MHz superscalar RISC microprocessor
genre_map.authors_if_known: B. A. Gieseke, R. L. Allmon, R. Bailey, B. Benschneider, S. M. Britton, L. Cloutier, S. Santhanam, et al.
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: Circuit design, global clock distribution, and physical floorplanning of the out-of-order Alpha 21264 (EV6) microprocessor in 0.35um CMOS.

genre_map.title: A 200-MHz 64-b dual-issue CMOS microprocessor
genre_map.authors_if_known: D. W. Dobberpuhl, V. M. Pensak, R. W. Witek, et al.
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: Physical layout, custom circuit design techniques, dynamic logic usage, and power/clock distribution for the original DEC Alpha 21064 processor.

genre_map.title: Circuit design methodology for a 4.5 GHz 32-nm dual-core zEnterprise microprocessor
genre_map.authors_if_known: G. Mayer, D. E. Hoffman, M. P. Vacek, et al.
genre_map.venue: IBM Journal of Research and Development
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: High-frequency clock tree design, noise mitigation, power grid optimization, and timing closure methodologies for IBM zEnterprise mainframe processors.

genre_map.title: Circuit design and implementation techniques for a 1GHz Itanium microprocessor
genre_map.authors_if_known: S. Rusu, S. Tam, et al.
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: Physical implementation, clock network distribution, custom circuit design, and bus interface timing closure for Intel's first-generation Itanium architecture.

genre_map.title: UltraSPARC-I: A 64-bit UltraSPARC processor for technical computing
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: Physical design partitioning, interconnect RC delay management, and execution pipeline timing trade-offs for Sun UltraSPARC-I.

genre_map.title: The circuit design of the POWER6 microprocessor
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: Circuit tuning, custom dynamic logic replacement, power optimization, and clock skew management achieving 5+ GHz operation in 65nm SOI.

genre_map.title: A 1 GHz Alpha microprocessor
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: 1 GHz operation physical design challenges in 0.18um CMOS, transmission line interconnect modeling, flip-chip packaging interaction, and low-power cache array implementation.

genre_map.title: Design and implementation of the AMD-K6 microprocessor
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: Physical design and timing closure of the x86 instruction decoder, x86-to-RISC translation matrix, and floorplan trade-offs for AMD-K6.
